An admin-only WordPress content and media workflow for controlled TXT import/export, ACF data, image metadata, previews and safe round-trip updates.

A WooCommerce product calculator that turns area and thickness inputs into required material quantities, bag counts and order-aware pricing metadata.
A WordPress service-management plugin with a dedicated content type, category taxonomy, searchable shortcode and CSV import/export.
A WordPress course-management plugin with course availability fields, responsive layouts, a shortcode and two public REST endpoints.
